ruleDefinitions.name: VeeamBackup Database Credentials Dump Via Sqlcmd.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects dump of credentials in VeeamBackup dbo

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\sqlcmd\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*SELECT.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*TOP.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\[VeeamBackup\\]\\\.\\[dbo\\]\\\.\\[Credentials\\].*")))
